Cost: 50eb (Costly)
Shield HP: 5

Fits a weapon's Gun Shield Mount attachment. It works as a Bulletproof Shield (mods and Tech Upgrades included), but only while that weapon is held two-handed and you haven't moved more than 4m/yds on foot this Round. Deploy or retract it as an Action, or while stowing the weapon or setting up a Bipod; deployed, the weapon can't be concealed. A destroyed Gun Shield is gone for good, and fitting a new one takes 1 minute.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Rails & Mounts > Gun Shield Mount).
